info.title: Farad Hall API
info.description: The central that manages every Farad Orquestra. People sign in with a session cookie; devices sign every request with their Ed25519 key (the Hall protocol v1, protocol/v1).

post.summary: Enrol: a claim code and a new public key become a device of a site
post.description: The device generates its Ed25519 key pair, then sends the claim code an admin created in Hall with its public key, signed with that key (Hall-Device absent; the canonical string ends in "enrol"). A claim code is single use and lives 24 h.

parameters.name: Hall-Timestamp
parameters.description: Unix seconds; within 300 s of Hall's clock

parameters.name: Hall-Nonce
parameters.description: Unique per request (16–128 of A–Z a–z 0–9 _ -); Hall refuses one seen within 600 s

parameters.name: Hall-Signature
parameters.description: Ed25519 signature (base64url, 64 bytes) of the HALL-ED25519-V1 canonical string

400.description: Not JSON

401.description: Signature missing or wrong (unauthorized, bad-signature), stale timestamp (stale-timestamp, with serverTime), replayed nonce (replayed-nonce), unknown device (unknown-device)

409.description: This public key is already enrolled (already-enrolled)

410.description: The claim code expired (claim-code-expired) or was used (claim-code-used): ask for a new one

422.description: Invalid message (invalid, with issues), or a protocol version Hall does not accept (unsupported-protocol, with supportedVersions)

429.description: Too many failed attempts from this address (rate-limited)

hallSignature.name: Hall-Signature
hallSignature.description:
Ed25519 request signature (HALL-ED25519-V1). The device signs the UTF-8 bytes of

    HALL-ED25519-V1
<METHOD>
<path and query>
<Hall-Timestamp>
<Hall-Nonce>
<lower-case hex SHA-256 of the body bytes>
<Hall-Device, or "enrol">

with the private key it generated, and sends the signature in Hall-Signature (base64url, no padding), with the hall-device, hall-timestamp and hall-nonce headers. See protocol/v1/README.md and test-vectors.json.
